questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From 00:12 to 00:20, the board is fully visible in the center and clearly holds exactly three pens arranged in a row.
All three pens are oriented vertically with the black grip/cap end pointing downwards. They are aligned parallel to each other.
All three pens appear to be identical black gel pens with translucent barrels and black grips/caps. There is no color mismatch.
All pens appear to have their caps on (or grips at the bottom) and are of equal length. No bare writing tips are exposed.

The board moves from left to center (00:00-00:12), then stops completely and remains stationary in the center for several seconds (00:12-00:20), before resuming movement to the right (00:21 onwards). This pause violates the smooth continuous motion requirement.
The pens remain fixed in their positions relative to the board throughout the movement and the pause.

parsed.reason: The board exhibits a significant pause in the middle of its travel (from approx 00:12 to 00:20), violating the requirement for smooth, continuous motion without stopping or freezing.

description: The board pauses mid-travel, then continues.
